blurb: Guests can enjoy craft beer, house-made pub classics, seasonal dishes, and participate in weekly events such as trivia nights, drag shows, karaoke, and paint & sip parties. Locations include a large rustic brewpub in Squamish with mountain views, and taphouses in East Van and New West. The venues host special events and are family and dog friendly in certain areas and seasons.
